item.title: Tata Steel to sell tubes, pipes business and Tata Steel Colors to APL Apollo for Rs 28,000 crore
item.description: Tata Steel approved the sale of its steel tubes and pipes business to APL Apollo Tubes for Rs 11,700 crore. The company also agreed to sell its entire stake in Tata Steel Colors for Rs 16,300 crore. Both transactions received approval from the board during a meeting held on Sunday. Tata Steel's operations in multiple locations will be transferred to APL Apollo on a slump sale basis.

item.title: Pilots' body seeks urgent financial, safety audit of crisis-hit SpiceJet
item.description: The Federation of Indian Pilots has requested the Directorate General of Civil Aviation to evaluate SpiceJet's financial stability and safety protocols. They highlighted the urgent need for an assessment due to rising flight cancellations and operational disruptions. SpiceJet's board recently approved a significant financial raising to improve its situation. The pilots' association seeks mandatory assessments for all airlines facing financial distress.

item.title: JK Urbanscapes to invest Rs 1,000 cr to build 6 hotels, plans Rs 4,500-cr housing projects
item.description: JK Urbanscapes Developers Ltd is embarking on an ambitious journey with a series of real estate projects that promise lucrative returns. The company aims to launch six hotels in various locations, including Kanpur and Mussoorie, while also working on a sprawling 90-acre township in Kanpur and a senior living initiative in Gurugram.

item.title: Petrol, diesel prices rose 7% in India vs 50-70% globally over four years: Hardeep Puri
item.description: Union Minister Hardeep Singh Puri announced that fuel prices in India have risen by just 7% over four years. The government implemented three reductions in central excise duty, helping maintain stable prices. Puri criticized rumors of an LPG shortage, emphasizing increased domestic production of LPG. Challenges from international conflicts and geopolitical tensions still persist, affecting the crude oil market.

item.title: CAIT credits PM Modi's appeal for nearly 40% fall in gold import bill
item.description: India's gold import bill fell by nearly 40 percent in the first seven months of 2026. Prime Minister Narendra Modi's appeal for citizens to avoid non-essential gold purchases appears to have influenced this decline. October alone witnessed a substantial 62.57 percent drop in gold imports year on year. Additionally, the World Gold Council reported a significant reduction in overall gold demand.

item.title: MPCB asks Adani firm to stop excavation work for temporary labour shed in Satara
item.description: Maharashtra Pollution Control Board issued a stop-work notice to Adani Renewable Energy One Ltd for unauthorized excavation. The notice pertains to a temporary labour camp related to a 1500 MW project in Satara district. The company commenced work without the necessary environmental clearance and approvals from the board. MPCB officials visited the site and proposed legal action following the unauthorised activities.

item.title: Aditya Birla Real Estate aims Rs 15,000 crore annual pre-sales in three years
item.description: Aditya Birla Real Estate Ltd has set an ambitious target of achieving Rs 15,000 crore in annual pre-sales. The company recorded sales bookings of over Rs 8,000 crore during the past two financial years. Currently, it is focused on sustaining sales in ongoing projects while planning several upcoming launches. The company highlights significant growth potential in the Delhi-NCR market and plans to acquire additional land.

item.title: Johnnie Walker-owner overtakes Pernod Ricard as India's largest alco-bev firm; Radico Khaitan in 3rd place
item.description: Pernod Ricard India reported a significant revenue decline of 13.6% in FY26, primarily due to the sale of Imperial Blue. Consequently, the company lost its status as the largest alcoholic beverage player to Diageo India. In contrast, Radico Khaitan experienced a strong performance with a nearly 22.7% increase in total income. The overall alco-bev market saw a combined revenue drop of over 5% in the same period.

item.title: Grid constraints, slower project awards may weigh on solar capacity growth beyond FY28: Report
item.description: India's solar capacity additions have increased significantly, reaching 44.61 GW in FY26, with continued momentum in FY27. Rooftop solar initiatives, alongside agricultural programs, have bolstered demand, particularly under the PM Surya Ghar scheme. However, there has been a noticeable slowdown in new renewable energy project awards, raising concerns about future expansion. Transmission challenges are also affecting grid performance, notably in Rajasthan and Gujarat.

item.title: Non-coal mining projects spread up to 500 hectares now to be appraised at state level
item.description: New regulations will allow environmental clearance for non-coal mining projects up to 500 hectares at the state level. This decision is expected to further decentralise the environment clearance process for these projects. State Environment Impact Assessment Authorities will be responsible for granting the clearances, enhancing efficiency. The change follows a draft notification issued earlier this year, highlighting the experience of state bodies.

item.title: Shree Cement targets 100 MT capacity in 3-4 years on India growth bet
item.description: Shree Cement plans to expand its production capacity to over 100 million tonnes per annum within four years. The company aims for a growth rate of 9-10 percent, surpassing the industry average. They have announced significant investments in new plants across various states in India to support this expansion. Shree Cement is also growing its ready-mix concrete operations, planning to increase capacity significantly.

item.title: PNB needs Rs 5,000 crore extra provisions under ECL, CEO sees limited impact
item.description: Punjab National Bank expects an additional provision of approximately Rs 5,000 crore due to ECL migration. They initially estimated higher but reduced the expected requirement based on digital assessments. The bank has created dedicated platforms for credit cards, supply chain management, and cash management services. These initiatives are expected to enhance the bank's non-interest income during challenging times.

item.title: ORN Ventures gears up for global travel business push with Rs 10,000 cr investment
item.description: ORN Ventures intends to invest over Rs 10,000 crore globally to enhance travel infrastructure and operations. The company aims to deepen its presence in international markets while scaling its direct operator-to-consumer platform. Investments will focus on building physical infrastructure and transport operations across 50-60 countries. Additionally, ORN plans to expand its franchisee network to 100 cities within India.

item.title: Reliance Brands trims losses in FY26, adds Stella McCartney, Fabletics to portfolio
item.description: Reliance Brands has reported a revenue increase of 3.77 percent to Rs 3,390.89 crore for FY26. The company narrowed its losses to Rs 137.04 crore, compared to Rs 233.79 crore the previous year. It expanded its portfolio by adding globally recognized brands like Stella McCartney and Kurt Geiger. RBL operates over 1,085 Points of Sale across India as of March 31, 2026.

item.title: Chalet Hotels plans Rs 3,500 crore capex in 3 years; Delhi airport hotel to open 200 rooms: CEO
item.description: Chalet Hotels aims to invest Rs 3,500 crore in expanding its hospitality portfolio over the next three years. The company will increase the number of rooms at its Taj property at Delhi airport to nearly 200. Several other projects are underway, including a Ritz-Carlton in Hyderabad and Hyatt Regency in Airoli. The company is cautious about expanding its Athiva brand until financial viability is proven.

item.title: Govt tightens rules for oil, gas block extensions, seeks bigger profit share
item.description: The Indian government has updated its production-sharing contracts policy for seven oil and gas blocks. Extensions may last until a field's economic life ends, subject to performance criteria. Contractors must apply two years before contracts expire and aid thorough audits of recoverable reserves. Increased government profit shares are mandated during the extended period of the contracts. The policy aims to ensure better returns and compliance from contractors while offering flexibility.

item.title: Union Budget 2028: Aluminium product makers seek duty-free imports for primary metal
item.description: India budget 2027-28: aluminium product manufacturers have made a request to the government. They are seeking a reduction of the customs duty on primary aluminium from 7.5 percent to zero percent. This change is intended to enhance the competitiveness of micro, small, and medium enterprises in the sector. The manufacturers argue that current policies impose high costs on domestic production while allowing imports at lower rates.

item.title: India's oil, gas import bill jumps 60% in October as Brent nearly doubles; cooking-gas usage falls
item.description: India's net oil and gas import bill rose 60% year-on-year to $16 billion in October as Brent crude prices nearly doubled. Crude imports cost $19.5 billion despite a modest increase in volumes, while LPG consumption and imports contracted sharply amid shipping disruptions through the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Airbnb looks beyond traditional holiday hubs to deepen India presence, bets on homestays
item.description: Airbnb plans to expand beyond established Indian holiday destinations, tapping demand for spiritual, cultural, rural and nature-led travel. The company is focusing on increasing homestay supply, training local hosts and entrepreneurs, and deploying AI-powered tools. Domestic travel accounted for over 85% of bookings by Indian guests in H1 2026.

item.title: CTI writes to PM Modi, thanks him for appeal to curb gold purchases
item.description: CTI expressed gratitude to Prime Minister Narendra Modi for his advice against purchasing gold. This guidance reportedly saved jewellers and traders from substantial financial losses during a significant price drop. The letter highlighted that many families benefitted from the advice as gold prices fell significantly. Modi's recommendations came during a period marked by economic challenges related to rising prices.

item.title: EV brand E-Went eyes mass market, to test sodium-ion batteries from December
item.description: Saraogi E-Ventures plans to explore sodium-ion battery technology for electric scooters starting in December. The company aims to capture demand in India's sub-Rs 1 lakh market segment. Currently, most electric models utilize lithium-ion technology, which is more common. The company intends to enhance its presence in states where it operates rather than pursuing national expansion. The long-term goal is to achieve profitability by 2028 with increased sales.

item.title: Gokul hikes buffalo milk price by Rs 6, cow milk by Rs 4 per litre; farmers say increase inadequate
item.description: Gokul Milk Union has announced a price increase for buffalo and cow milk due to the drought conditions. The changes include a rise in procurement rates for farmers, although some have expressed dissatisfaction. Farmers argue that the increase does not adequately address their rising costs for cattle feed and fodder. The adjusted prices will be effective from November 21 and will be reviewed monthly.

item.title: RBI Guv Sanjay Malhotra urges banks to step up small-business lending for greater economic gains
item.description: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra emphasized the need for banks to focus on lending to small enterprises. He highlighted that the impact of such lending is significantly broader than loans to large businesses. The Governor also underlined the importance of promoting financial literacy and ensuring cautious use of digital banking. Additionally, he mentioned the ongoing financial inclusion camps aimed at bridging service gaps in communities.

item.title: Train service between Ayodhya, Janakpur Dham adds new dimension to India-Nepal longstanding partnership
item.description: A new passenger train service between Ayodhya Dham and Janakpur Dham will be launched soon. This service aims to strengthen cultural ties and improve travel convenience for families and pilgrims. Key rail stops will enhance accessibility across several districts in India and Nepal. Commercial interactions and tourism opportunities are expected to grow as a result of improved connectivity.

item.title: Hero MotoCorp gets tribunal relief on Rs 27 crore income tax demand
item.description: The Income Tax Appellate Tribunal has provided significant relief to Hero MotoCorp regarding an income tax demand. The outstanding demand amount was reduced to approximately Rs 27 crore across six assessment years. Originally, the tax authority had raised a demand of Rs 604.87 crore after disallowing certain expenses. Hero MotoCorp had previously appealed against the demands and successfully lowered it over time.

item.title: Retired Boeing 737-200 moved from Kolkata to Bengaluru for aircraft recovery training
item.description: Aircraft dismantling and relocation platform PROMQT MRO has successfully moved a retired Boeing 737-200 to Bengaluru. This project involved extensive engineering and logistical planning over three months to complete. The aircraft, named 'Phoenix,' will be used for on-site recovery and training by Bangalore International Airport Limited. By repurposing a grounded airliner, the project emphasizes sustainable aviation practices within India.

item.title: Ashok Leyland to set up truck plant in West Bengal's Singur, says Union minister Sukanta Majumdar
item.description: Union Minister Sukanta Majumdar announced that Ashok Leyland plans to build a truck manufacturing plant in Singur. The project is expected to begin soon, reviving hopes for industrialisation in the area. Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari had previously stated discussions regarding this plant had taken place. Successive state governments have been blamed for failing to attract major industries to West Bengal.

item.title: Bloom raises $75 million in latest funding round from Kedaara
item.description: Bloom, the tech-driven travel brand has raised $75m in their latest funding round through an investment by Kedaara Capital. The infusion is in the form of a primary investment by Kedaara and will principally be used to support Bloom’s next phase of growth along with the continued development of the brand’s pioneering tech and product.

item.title: USFDA issues 7 observations to NATCO Pharma's Hyderabad facility
item.description: NATCO Pharma Limited reported receiving seven observations from the USFDA following an inspection of its manufacturing facility. The inspection took place from November 12 to November 20 in Hyderabad. The company stated that the issued Form 483 highlights procedural observations as potential violations. NATCO Pharma expressed confidence in addressing the observations within specified timelines. The company aims to resolve these issues comprehensively and ensure compliance going forward.

item.title: India's position in global manufacturing heirarchy evolving rapidly: Rockwell Automation MD
item.description: Dilip Sawhney of Rockwell Automation said India is experiencing significant growth in its manufacturing sector. The company is expanding its operations and workforce significantly in India to integrate more fully into global value chains. Sawhney noted challenges in recruiting skilled workers despite the large population, emphasising the need for aspirational manufacturing jobs. New greenfield capacities are being developed to enhance manufacturing competitiveness for Indian industries.

item.title: US drug regulator classifies Aurobindo Pharma arm's Andhra facility as 'voluntary action indicated'
item.description: Aurobindo Pharma Limited has announced that its subsidiary, Apitoria Pharma Pvt Ltd, received a VAI classification for its facility. The classification indicates that some objectionable conditions were found, but no regulatory actions will occur. The inspection took place from August 24 to August 28, 2026, by the USFDA.

item.title: NCLT disposes of dissolution plea for Zydus Wellness' erstwhile subsidiary Naturell India
item.description: Zydus Wellness Limited reported that the National Company Law Tribunal has disposed of Naturell (India) Pvt Ltd's dissolution petition. The tribunal sought further clarification and supporting documents, allowing the liquidator to file a new application. Zydus Wellness had earlier agreed to the voluntary liquidation of Naturell, and its business was transferred in 2025. The liquidation petition was initially filed in March 2026 under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code.

item.title: OfBusiness to invest Rs 200 crore in Andhra Pradesh to scale up apparel manufacturing
item.description: OfBusiness intends to invest Rs 200 crore in Andhra Pradesh to enhance apparel manufacturing operations. The company aims to create approximately 12,000 direct and indirect jobs through this expansion project. Additionally, the new facility will complement the existing manufacturing unit in Anantapur. The focus will be on producing woven apparel for both domestic and international markets. This investment aligns with OfBusiness's growth strategy in the apparel sector across South India.

item.title: IndusInd Bank ends ex-CEO Kathpalia's employment, seeks to recover pay
item.description: IndusInd Bank has ended the employment of Sumant Kathpalia following a disciplinary investigation into misconduct. After misreporting accounting details led to significant financial losses, disciplinary proceedings were initiated against him. The bank's board decided to terminate his employment and pursue recovery of his compensation since March 2020. Concurrently, the bank experienced a return to double-digit growth in loans and deposits. IndusInd's shares have shown recovery, rising by 16% this year.

item.title: Honda debuts hybrid SUV as it recalibrates EV strategy
item.description: The Avancier will go on sale next spring, targeting markets including Japan, China and Australia, Honda said Friday. The manufacturer declined to reveal the price of the 6-seater sport utility vehicle that will be built primarily in Thailand.

item.title: Healthcare philanthropy in India up 82 pc to Rs 1,768 crore in FY26: Report
item.description: Philanthropic donations towards healthcare in India saw a significant rise of 82 per cent in FY26. The EdelGive Hurun India Philanthropy List 2026 reported that healthcare was the second-most popular cause. A total of 175 philanthropists contributed to this sector, showcasing increased private involvement. Education remains the leading philanthropic area with donations totaling Rs 4,188 crore.

item.title: Chubu Electric picks up Rs 1,350 crore stake in Continuum Green Energy
item.description: Chubu Electric is investing Rs 1,350 crore in Continuum Green Energy, which was founded by two IIM-Ahmedabad classmates. This investment is part of a broader trend of interest from major investors, including Just Climate. Chubu Electric aims to provide not just capital, but also operational knowledge gained from years in the power sector. The partnership is expected to benefit both companies in the Indian renewable energy market.

item.title: Titan to expand premium watch business, target 500 Helios stores in three years
item.description: Titan, which currently operates around 316 stores under its Helios and Helios Luxe formats, plans to add 40-50 stores annually, including premium Helios Luxe outlets, said Rahul Shukla, Vice President and Chief Sales and Marketing Officer, Watches Division, Titan Company Ltd.

item.title: India's smartphone sales during festive season drop by 22%, Apple faces a double-digit dip
item.description: Smartphone sales in India experienced a significant decline of 22 percent during the 2026 festive season. Rising device prices, largely driven by increased memory costs, contributed to weaker consumer demand. Major brands like Samsung, Vivo, and Apple faced challenges with sales declines, while emerging brands showed growth. Discounts offered were lower this year compared to the previous year, further affecting purchases.

item.title: Blue Dart Express launches 'next day' delivery service from Srinagar to 5 major cities
item.description: Blue Dart Express has launched a next-day delivery service from Srinagar to five major metropolitan cities. This initiative enables local businesses to connect more effectively with customers throughout India and globally. The new service is expected to boost the economy in Jammu & Kashmir and enhance logistics for various industries. E-commerce sellers and MSMEs will particularly benefit from improved shipping capabilities.

item.title: Track trials of India's indigenous bullet train expected by mid-2027; first service begins late 2027
item.description: India's first indigenous B28 bullet train is being manufactured for the Mumbai-Ahmedabad corridor and track trials are scheduled. The train, designed for a speed of 280 kmph, is expected to improve travel time significantly. Construction began in 2021 after delays caused by state permissions and the COVID-19 pandemic. The first service is anticipated to commence by the end of 2027.

item.title: Anant Ambani's Vantara airlifts critically ill seven-week-old elephant calf Raja from Assam to Gujarat
item.description: A seven-week-old Asian elephant calf named Raja is being urgently airlifted from Assam to Gujarat for specialized medical attention. Raja was born with a critical injury, leading to several health issues, including infections and nutritional deficits from not receiving enough mother’s milk. Despite the dedicated care from the Vantara team, hospitalization has become essential for Raja to undergo a thorough veterinary evaluation and receive necessary treatments upon arrival.

item.title: Ravi Kishan and Rakhi Sawant turn hotel deals into the internet’s latest talking point
item.description: Ravi Kishan’s latest reel has gone viral amongst Gen Z, taking inspiration from meme culture while providing great value this travel season.

item.title: Reliance, Indian Oil, other Indian refiners race to secure oil tankers as freight costs rise
item.description: Indian refiners are increasingly looking for long-term tanker contracts to secure crude supplies effectively. The ongoing disruptions in the Persian Gulf have led to rising freight costs and tighter vessel availability. Reliance Industries has expanded its supertanker contracts from seven to about a dozen to mitigate risks. State-owned Indian Oil Corp. is also seeking to enhance its long-term tanker leases amid market uncertainties.

item.title: Coal mine auction bids rise fourfold, 85 offers for 18 blocks across India
item.description: Bids for commercial coal mines surged in the latest round, with a total of 85 submissions received. The Ministry of Coal reported participation from 20 first-time bidders showcasing increased interest in the auction process. A technical committee will evaluate the bids to shortlist qualified participants for the upcoming electronic auction. Production from coal mines is projected to rise significantly, contributing to job creation and revenue.

item.title: Refund for RAC travellers who don't get full berth? What to know as Railways considers scrapping 'unfair' system where two people share one berth but pay full fare
item.description: Indian Railways is examining whether to scrap its decades-old Reservation Against Cancellation (RAC) facility, under which two passengers share a single berth while paying the full ticket fare.

item.title: Govt to expand Unified EV charging platform beyond five-state pilot as network strengthens
item.description: The government plans to gradually expand the Unified Bharat e-Charge platform beyond its five-state pilot as more charging network operators join, Heavy Industries Ministry official Hanif Qureshi said. Around 12 operators are currently integrated into the platform, which allows EV users to locate, access and pay for charging services through a single interface.

item.title: Andhra govt to tap nuclear power through SMR tech as alternative to thermal power
item.description: The Andhra Pradesh government has approved exploring nuclear power generation using Small Modular Reactor (SMR) technology as an alternative to thermal power. The state will examine setting up nuclear plants at retiring thermal power units or other suitable locations once the technology stabilises, with private sector participation also permitted.

item.title: Premium flagship smartphone prices likely to go up by over 30% by year-end: Counterpoint
item.description: Prices for premium flagship smartphones are expected to increase significantly due to rising memory chip costs. Market research indicates that memory prices will constitute a larger portion of total smartphone costs. Brands like Oppo and Apple are experiencing notable price hikes as a result of this trend. Consumer expectations are also evolving, emphasising the importance of various smartphone specifications.

item.title: DGCA issues show cause notice to SpiceJet on flight cancellations, various violations
item.description: SpiceJet is facing scrutiny from the DGCA due to significant operational challenges impacting its flight operations. The airline has seen a decline in its domestic market share along with increased flight cancellations and delays. The DGCA has requested explanations for the decline in operational performance and non-compliance with regulations. Issues cited include a majority of the fleet being grounded and delayed payments to service providers.
